# Ghostty Config: Dyslexia, ADHD & Late-Night Edition

> Ghostty-first terminal ergonomics and universal theme-sync CLI (`ghostty-theme` / `theme-sync`) syncing 22 calibrated themes (including Gotham Noir) and Monaspace Neon typography across 16+ terminals and IDEs on macOS and Linux. Maintained by Zain Ahmed (https://zainahmed.net/).

## Agent Setup & Skills
- [Agent Skill (SKILL.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thezaynahmed/ghostty-config/main/skills/ghostty-config/SKILL.md): Installable Agent Skill (`npx skills add thezaynahmed/ghostty-config`).
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thezaynahmed/ghostty-config/main/AGENTS.md): Step-by-step installer flags, theme-sync usage, and validation.
- [Shell Icons & Prompt Docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thezaynahmed/ghostty-config/main/docs/shell-icons.md): Starship profiles, eza/fzf integration, Linux prerequisites.
